genius.notes: Monerium hf is an Icelandic EMI and GBPe is documented as a regulated, redeemable e-money token. No token-specific GENIUS approval, state-qualified status, official application, or OCC foreign-issuer registration was found in the public U.S. materials reviewed on 2026-08-14. The OCC foreign-issuer registration and Treasury comparability materials reviewed remain proposed-rulemaking, so foreignExceptionStatus stays unknown rather than asserting a qualification failure.
